gloss: going to work; coming to the office

definitions.gloss: going to work; coming to the office
definitions.explanation: The act of going to one's workplace, typically an office.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}9{時|じ}に{出社|しゅっしゃ}する。
examples.english: I go to work at 9 o'clock every morning.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{出社|しゅっしゃ}せずに{在宅|ざいたく}で{働|はたら}く。
examples.english: I'll work from home today instead of going to the office.

examples.japanese: {出社|しゅっしゃ}{時間|じかん}が{早|はや}くなった。
examples.english: The time I go to work has become earlier.

notes:
COMPONENTS:
{出|しゅつ} (to go out) + {社|しゃ} (company)

CONTRAST WITH {退社|たいしゃ}:
- {出社|しゅっしゃ}: going to work/office
- {退社|たいしゃ}: leaving work or resigning from a company

REGISTER:
Neutral. Standard workplace vocabulary.

MODERN USAGE:
With the rise of remote work, {出社|しゅっしゃ} is often contrasted with {在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ} (working from home) or リモートワーク (remote work).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出社|しゅっしゃ}する: to go to work
- {出社|しゅっしゃ}{時間|じかん}: arrival time at work
- {出社|しゅっしゃ}{日|び}: days in the office
- {週|しゅう}に{何日|なんにち}{出社|しゅっしゃ}: how many days a week in the office
